summary: Fix StrPrinter multiplication denominators to parenthesize reciprocal and reciprocal-square-root powers printed with a slash, preserving the grouping of nested LaTeX fractions in both multiplication paths. Add regressions for unit/symbol numerators, reciprocal square roots, the issue expression, and mathematical string round trips. Before fix: test_str.py had 100 passed and the new regression failed. After fix: test_str.py 101 passed; test_python.py and test_repr.py 55 passed, 1 expected failure. LaTeX parser reproduction/test unavailable because antlr4 runtime is missing; reproduced the exact erroneous output directly from the expression structure built by convert_frac. Inspected final diff.
